title: UnbeatablyOptimized
description: This is a modpack that adds tons of optimization mods!
body:
⚡ Ultimate Fabric Optimization Modpack (1.21.10)

Tired of lag spikes and low FPS? This pack is made to make Minecraft run smoother, faster, and cleaner — while keeping that classic vanilla feel.

🧱 Included Mods

Not Enough Animations – Restores missing first-person animations.

Sodium – The ultimate FPS booster and rendering overhaul.

EntityCulling – Stops rendering entities you can’t see for big performance gains.

Konkrete [Library] – Core library required by several mods.

Fabric API [API] – The backbone of most Fabric mods.

Mod Menu – Easily view and manage your installed mods.

StutterFix – Smooths frame timing and reduces lag spikes.

Lithium – Optimizes game logic and tick performance.

Just Zoom – Lightweight, simple zoom feature.

Architectury [API] – Ensures cross-mod compatibility.

Fabric Language Kotlin [FAK] – Adds support for Kotlin-based mods.

ImmediatelyFast – Further improves rendering performance.

🚀 Features

✅ Major FPS boosts on most systems
✅ Smooth gameplay with minimal lag or stutter
✅ 100% vanilla-friendly — no gameplay changes
✅ Works perfectly on Fabric 1.21.10
✅ Plug-and-play setup — no manual tweaks needed

📦 Requirements

Minecraft: 1.21.10

Loader: Fabric

Java: 21 or higher ☕

RAM: 2GB+ recommended

💬 Notes

This pack focuses purely on performance and optimization — no visual overhauls, no new mechanics, just pure speed.

If you want Minecraft to run like butter, this pack’s for you.
👉 Download now and boost your FPS instantly!
